## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, dependencies, workflows
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` is green locally (lint + types + arch + semgrep + secrets + agents + context + tests + evals + benchmarks)
- [ ] New or updated tests cover the change
- [ ] **No secrets, tokens, or credentials** are committed (`.env` stays untracked)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `docs/` / Google-style docstrings)
